name: Call The Step
body:
School: evocation [sonic]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Prop: Pole

EFFECT

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Area: 5-ft.-wide wall extending from you out to the range limit

Duration: Instantaneous

Saving Throw: Reflex half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

You intensify your dance commands, compelling all observers to join in. Every creature within a certain boundary (the ‘wall’) suffers sonic damage as a result of this compelling performance. The damage is calculated as 1d6 (one six-sided die roll) plus an additional point for each of your caster levels.

If you’re using a jester’s pole while performing this action, you gain an additional effect. You can exert force on one target that fails their save vs. the above effect, pushing them away from you. The distance you can push them is equal to five times your Dexterity modifier, measured in feet.
